book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Yudas qo kwa
Satiboukeing lulayang, eno xel lumuki leitata dalus me xel teivateiv wei xel xomaxoneing eno lam me di luklek qayeeng bei nyeis Yesu e mey.
Xel tup e, de qou e me la wou eivek Pailat mema, lei ngandoung wei seyap o.

Yudas tiwei neil Yesu teyei me toung e la eivek xel vevek memend o, yei bei xel byex qayeeng lek Yesu woy bei nyeis e mey, om moxo kwa pakou no me qou malew selewa xoumeeng yal (30) wei xel lumuki leitata me xel teivateiv wong wou e yo me lox wong elox wou xel.
Moxo neil, “A wo sewokeing, en a neil tambiy wei nilul ma veil e yo teyei me na toung e lak eivek xam memamim.” Xel neil elox bei, “Inyon se dei yeip wou xa ti. Qe inyon di yeip wou wamaxow o.”
Om Yudas nex malew lox eivek xomek vambuing lalei dom la. Woyom Yudas venaxow la qo kwa me mey.
Xel lumuki leitata zeim malew lek me neil, “Inye se la teyei lek qayeeng petieing bei xey a toung malew tine na eivek deng xeikatu wei xomek vambuing yo, en inye malew wei qapyex gyand o.”
Om xel luk wouma me tup qayeeng bei dexouv tembuing wei xel wei mi betiy dengmuing o en malew tiyon en leiveeng meyeing wei xel amba yo.
Om qes ambei nyon xel mi taxe Tembuing on Gyand me elam tyip gweimbeeng ne is.
Woyom lul tine la teyei lek lulti Anutu neil eivek poropet Yelemia mya yo.

content.text: “Xel qou malew selewa xoumeeng yal (30) on teyei lek ambei xouveing wei xel xomaxoneing wei Israel beyal bei dexouv tambiy tiyon o,
me xel xouv tembuing wei xel wei mi betiy dengmuing en o ti, nambei Tambiy Ngandoung peti wou ay yo.” Sakarias 11:12-13

content: Yesu nale wou Pailat manghalus
Dekale Yesu nale wou lei ngandoung wei seyap o ma, me moxo teling e, “Beip wang on king wei Yudayeiw o?” Yesu neil elox bei, “Nambei wang neil on.”
De woyom xel lumuki leitata me teivateiv byex qayeeng lek Yesu, moxo se neil qayeeng ti lox wou xel.
Woyom Pailat teling e, “Beip inye wa seng ngo pavulek wei xel di luk en wang ne?”
Ekom Yesu se neil lulti lox, de se neil lulti lek qayeeng wei xel byex lek e yon, om tine wong lei ngandoung wei seyap o wounalei ngenong.
Lei ngandoung wei seyap o xe kwa wei mi betiwou lek bouk wei Pasova eno mi tul xeitueing ti la teyei lek xel moux alis vex mi beyal o laleind.
Lek bouk kayon eno tambiy nilul ayang ti lei Barabas eno toundei eivek xeitueing.
Om xel qendu yon qekuma, Pailat teling xel, “Luw nge na xam ambei a bong e nak wou xam, Barabas o Yesu wei xel mi taxe bei Kilisi yo?”
En moxo woulek bei xel venaxow xe laleind nilul, om xel qou Yesu me wong wou e.

Ka Pailat toundei lek sia wei ngoeing qayeeng o, moxo venei wong qayeeng tine lam wou e: “Kandek wa seng bong lulti lek moux wei bombek o, en inye a axe nimaying ngandoung ti gweimbeeng eivek maviing en e.”
Ekom xel lumuki leitata me xel teivateiv zeim xel qendu ngandoung on laleind lek bei e bong Barabas na wou xel dom nyeis Yesu e mey.
Lei ngandoung wei seyap o teling, “Xam ambei a bong luw nge na, nak wou xam?” Xel lewexe bei, “Barabas.”
Pailat teling, “De tyek a bong vati wou Yesu tiwei xel taxe bei Kilisi ne?” Xel dalus lewexe bei, “Tuw e lek xax pepeeng!”
Pailat teling, “En va? E wong sewokeing vati?” Ekom xel taxe lox wou e niseikeing bei, “Tuw e lek xax pepeeng!”

Pailat woulek bei tyek xel se ngo e vya, de inyon vevek ngandoung embei qandi lek, om moxo qou memiing me sekweyexe mema eivek xel qendu ngandoung on dalus mend. Moxo neil, “Inye se sewokeing wei ay yo en moux tine gyand. Qe inye di yeip wou xam venaxow!”
Xomaxoneing dalus lewexe, “Wong e xe gyand on lam lek xa me lek xa neumiyeiw!”
Woyom moxo wong Barabas la wou xel. Dom neil wou xel vevekyeiw on bei xel sesa Yesu nangya yisviyeing, dekakom wong e la me xel tuw lek xax pepeeng.
Xel vevekyeiw luk seloukeing lek Yesu
Woyom xel vevek wei lei ngandoung wei seyap o qou Yesu me la lalei eivek xomek seyap me qeku xel dalusateiv wei vevekyeiw o nale vivekwou e.
Xel kwax e xe teimb veil dom byex teimb ding gyand nge lek e no,

de xel bembinexe yis wei ying o lekti nambei qelumking de toung lek e lu. Xel toung xax nayak ti eivek e mema payeiv de dundek wou e ma me luk seloukeing lek e. Me neil, “Bendiyeing, king wei xel Yudayeiw o!”
De xel pesuv myend louk lek e, de xel qou e xe patongeeng me sesa e lu gya lumama.
Ka xel luk seloukeing lek e woy, xel kwax teimb wei xel byex lek e eno veil dom byex e maxow xe teimb lek no. Woyom xel qou e me la bei na tuw e lek xax pepeeng.
Xel tuw Yesu lek xax pepeeng
Xel di tupwou sakwaing me la, eno xel la tyip wou tambiy wei Sairini yo ti, lei Simon, om xel tendu bei moxo e qalei xax pepeeng.
Xel lam tyip wou beyeeng tiwei xel mi taxe bei Golgata (E qes ambei nye bei Beyeeng wei Lukanzek o).
Nanghei inyon eno xel wong wain wei xel maleeng is lul senyeing o wou Yesu bei e num. Moxo num me axe le, ekom se num.
Ka xel tuw e lek xax pepeeng woy, woyom xel nex qakous dee bei dembu e xe teimb wouma.
Xel dei tembuing, me di yei e teyei nanghei inyon.
Louk apu en e lu eno xel tuw qayeeng vati wei xel wong qayeeng en e yo bei: TINE INYE YESU, KING WEI YUDAYEIW O.
Tambiy panaxeing yayuw eno xel tuw luw is e, nge wou e mema payeiv, de nge wou e mema qeinz.
Eti yeiw wei di lam me la eno lukyak lek e, me bimexe lund
me neil, “Wa kawei wang neimbei tyek lelolexe xomek vambuing dom ghe dev vako eivek bouk yal o inyon, om vind xow! Wangwei wa Anutu Neu Moux nei, tei lam veil xax pepeeng!”
Eivek kwa kayon teyeima eno xel lumuki leitata me xel putoung wei petieing me xel teivateiv lukyak lek e.
Xel neil, “Moxo vind xel bamba, ekom se teyei bei devind venaxow! Wangwei e king wei xel Israel o, yon e detei nam veil xax pepeeng en kandek xey a bongis e.
Moxo mi wongis Anutu. Om wangwei Anutu lalei devind e nei yon e devind moxo, en mi neil embei, ‘A ne Anutu Neu Moux.’ ”
Eivek sakwaing ambei nyon eno panaxeing yuw wei xel tuw is e eno lukyak lek e is.
Yesu mey
Lek ingwei seivma evlek me e la seivma yal wei soukeing eno mapetok ngandoung sevunexe tembuing tambak on.
Me embim seivma yal eno Yesu taxe niseikeing bei, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani?” Qes ambei nye bei, “A xe Anutu, a xe Anutu, nambei nya wang saing ay?” Qapiya Lalo 22:1
Woyom xel valu wei toungale inyon ngo tine, om xel neil embei, “Moxo taxe Eliya yo.”
Lutika eno xel xe ti veimya me la qou balam. Moxo toung eivek wain senyeing me e pup, de tup lek xax mema nayak ti, dom zeim e la wou Yesu mya bei e num.
Xel valu neil embei, “Wong xey a axe le bei, Eliya nam devind e.”
Ekom Yesu nyayek niseikeing no, de wong e xe nulaweeng la dom mey.
Lek kayon bombek eno qaeing ngandoung wei mii eivek xomek vambuing lalei eno lexla yayuw anghei pu me ela nge xo. De tembuing pi me wong qakous on dembu.
Leiveeng meyeing ngenong mya tax de xel vambuing ngenong wei mey eno neing qandi lek mapieing.
Xel lam myayaing veil leiveeng meyeing, deka Yesu qandi lek woy eno xel la eivek beyeeng vambuing Yerusalem me tyip wou xel xomaxoneing ngenong.

Lei ngandoung wei vevek o is xel vevekyeiw toukale inyon is e me yei Yesu teyei eno yei tembuing pi me lul dalus tiwei qandi yon, om xel yaleeng, me neil, “Neing ayang tambiy tine inye Anutu Neu Moux!”
Xel vex ngenong toukale kwanding, me di yei. Xel on ingwei mi betiwou Yesu nanghei Galili bei na devind e.
Eivek vex vex on senghoing, inyon Maria wei Makdala me Maria wei Jems aluw Joses tend, me Sebedi neu luw tend.
Xel ev Yesu
Ka moxo di souk, tambiy wei lulul ana eno lam anghei Arimatia, e lei Yosep. Moxo yon betiyeing wei Yesu yo ti.
La wou Pailat, me teling wou en Yesu neing, om Pailat lewexe lek bei vevekyeiw bong Yesu neing na wou Yosep me e qou me na.
Yosep qou neing on me beliv eivek qaeing teleing vako ti,
me liw eivek e maxow xe leiveeng meyeing vako wei xel qateiv eivek qakous o. Dom moxo wilexe qakous ngandoung ti la zeyi leiveeng meyeing mya de la.
Maria wei Makdala luw Maria nge eno toundei inyon paviy leiveeng meyeing.
Xel belimbo nale zeyi leiveeng meyeing
Bouk wei Yudayeiw mi menyex wou lulul wei yaing eno lak veil, de bouk Sabat eno xel lumuki leitata me Parisiyeiw la wou Pailat.
Xel neil wou e bei, “Teiv, xa wou naleimi en tambiy tiwei tyonyeing on wei nanghei toundei mapieing eno neil, ‘Ka bouk yal nak veil on tyek a qandi lek no.’

Om wang bo qayeeng nikanzek en xel a toung leiveeng on mya zeyi embo nikanzek me ena tyip wou bouk yal. Enok e xe xel betiyeing nam me panax e neing dom na neil wou xel xomaxoneing bei moxo qandi lek veil meyeing. Tyonyeing tiwei yus ne tyek ghanaw tyonyeing wei wong a tax o.”
Pailat neil embei, “Xam a qou xel belimbo wei mi yeiteyei leiveeng meyeing mya yo ti. La wong leiveeng mya yon wo nikanzek nambei xam ghe wou naleimim en o.”
Om xel la lax leiveeng mya zeyi me toung newiy lek qakous dom wong xel belimbo la nale zeyi.
